## Purpose / 变更目的

Describe the problem, scope and resulting behavior.

## Validation / 验证

State checks performed and any checks intentionally not run.

## Change review / 提交自查

- [ ] No credentials, private data, internal addresses or sensitive screenshots are included.
- [ ] Scope and documentation are accurate; existing history is preserved.
- [ ] Risk, rollback and any configuration changes are described.
